headline: [Financial Stocks] Cathay Financial EPS of NT$6.47 for first 8 months; Cathay Life's net worth nears record high of NT$1 trillion - Finance
summary: Cathay Financial posted August after-tax net profit of NT$11.30 billion and cumulative first-eight-month profit of NT$98.64 billion. Cumulative EPS reached NT$6.47, and Cathay Life's net worth neared NT$1 trillion.
why: Cathay Financial is one of Taiwan's largest financial holding companies, with major life insurance and banking operations.
